question: What inner offering must be made into the great fire of the self?
premises: An offering is to be made into the great fire of the self.
The offering consists of the mind as a full oblation.
This inner act is prescribed as a condition.
inference: One should offer the mind as a full oblation into the great fire of the self.
plain_english: So long as one offers the mind as a full oblation into the great fire of the self.
